_comment: Administered fuel and CNG price evidence. PDFs archived under W:/Grid-Explorer/ (not committed); sha256 checks
the archived copy against the publisher. Figures in lib/data/tariff/administered-prices.ts were read from the page images
2026-09-30 (the EMRD PDFs carry a text layer in a legacy font encoding that garbles the extract; the BERC 2022 file is a scan).
CNG: the 2022 notification is the latest BERC instrument found stating the CNG rate. The April 2025 re-fixing covered the
industrial and captive-power categories only (its own title says so); no later CNG instrument appears in BERC notices to page 70.
